{"dialogues": [
  {"speaker": "O-lan", "speak_to": ["Wang Lung"], "text": "O-lan informed Wang Lung that there was another thing before she could die."},
  {"speaker": "Wang Lung", "speak_to": ["O-lan"], "text": "Wang Lung rebuked O-lan, stating that she could not speak of dying and please him."},
  {"speaker": "O-lan", "speak_to": ["Wang Lung"], "text": "O-lan explained to Wang Lung that she must die, as she felt it in her vitals, but would not die before her eldest son returned home and before he married the maid who was her daughter-in-law, and that she wanted him to ensure the maid served her well, holding the hot water basin steadily and knowing when to bathe her face when she sweated in pain. She added that she wanted her son to come home and for him to marry the maid first, so that she may die easily, knowing his grandson was stirred into life and a great grandson for the old one."},
  {"speaker": "Wang Lung", "speak_to": ["O-lan"], "text": "Wang Lung observed that O-lan looked twice as well as they said and years away from death."},
  {"speaker": "O-lan", "speak_to": ["Wang Lung"], "text": "O-lan assured Wang Lung that she would see him wed and then she must die."},
  {"speaker": "O-lan", "speak_to": ["Wang Lung"], "text": "O-lan remarked that the maid would be well, yet."},
  {"speaker": "O-lan", "speak_to": ["Wang Lung"], "text": "O-lan instructed Wang Lung to sit and drink the wine and eat the rice of his marriage, as she wished to witness it all, and that it would be his bed of marriage since she was soon to be finished with it and carried away."},
  {"speaker": "O-lan", "speak_to": ["Wang Lung"], "text": "O-lan inquired whether everyone had wine and if the sweet rice dish in the middle of the feast was very hot, and if they had put a full measure of lard and sugar into it and the eight fruits."},
  {"speaker": "O-lan", "speak_to": ["Wang Lung"], "text": "O-lan declared that she was content and that the thing in her may do as it will. She then instructed her son to look to his father and grandfather, and her daughter to look to her husband, his father, his grandfather, and the poor fool in the court, adding that she had no duty to any other."},
  {"speaker": "O-lan", "speak_to": ["Wang Lung"], "text": "O-lan conceded that even if she was ugly, she had borne a son, and that although she was but a slave, there was a son in her house."},
  {"speaker": "O-lan", "speak_to": ["Wang Lung"], "text": "O-lan questioned how that one could feed him and care for him as she did, asserting that beauty would not bear a man sons."}
]}

{"dialogues": [{"speaker": "Mr. Darcy", "speak_to": ["Elizabeth"], "text": "In vain have I struggled. It will not do. My feelings will not be repressed. You must allow me to tell you how ardently I admire and love you."}, {"speaker": "Elizabeth", "speak_to": ["Mr. Darcy"], "text": "She answered him with cold civility."}, {"speaker": "Mr. Darcy", "speak_to": ["Elizabeth"], "text": "His sense of her inferiority, of its being a degradation, of the family obstacles which judgment had always opposed to inclination, were dwelt on with a warmth which seemed due to the consequence he was wounding, but was very unlikely to recommend his suit."}, {"speaker": "Mr. Darcy", "speak_to": ["Elizabeth"], "text": "He concluded with representing to her the strength of that attachment which in spite of all his endeavours he had found impossible to conquer; and with expressing his hope that it would now be rewarded by her acceptance of his hand."}, {"speaker": "Elizabeth", "speak_to": ["Mr. Darcy"], "text": "In such cases as this, it is, I believe, the established mode to express a sense of obligation for the sentiments avowed, however unequally they may be returned. It is natural that obligation should be felt, and if I could feel gratitude, I would now thank you. But I cannot--I have never desired your good opinion, and you have certainly bestowed it most unwillingly. I am sorry to have occasioned pain to anyone. It has been most unconsciously done, however, and I hope will be of short duration. The feelings which you tell me have long prevented the acknowledgment of your regard can have little difficulty in overcoming it after this explanation."}, {"speaker": "Mr. Darcy", "speak_to": ["Elizabeth"], "text": "And this is all the reply which I am to have the honour of expecting! I might, perhaps, wish to be informed why, with so little endeavour at civility, I am thus rejected. But it is of small importance."}, {"speaker": "Elizabeth", "speak_to": ["Mr. Darcy"], "text": "I might as well inquire why, with so evident a design of offending and insulting me, you chose to tell me that you liked me against your will, against your reason, and even against your character? Was not this some excuse for incivility, if I was uncivil? But I have other provocations. You know I have. Had not my own feelings decided against you, had they been indifferent, or had they even been favourable, do you think that any consideration would tempt me to accept the man who has been the means of ruining, perhaps for ever, the happiness of a most beloved sister?"}, {"speaker": "Elizabeth", "speak_to": ["Mr. Darcy"], "text": "I have every reason in the world to think ill of you. No motive can excuse the unjust and ungenerous part you acted there. You dare not, you cannot deny that you have been the principal, if not the only means of dividing them from each other, of exposing one to the censure of the world for caprice and instability, the other to its derision for disappointed hopes, and involving them both in misery of the acutest kind."}, {"speaker": "Elizabeth", "speak_to": ["Mr. Darcy"], "text": "Can you deny that you have done it?"}, {"speaker": "Mr. Darcy", "speak_to": ["Elizabeth"], "text": "I have no wish of denying that I did everything in my power to separate my friend from your sister, or that I rejoice in my success. Towards him I have been kinder than towards myself."}, {"speaker": "Elizabeth", "speak_to": ["Mr. Darcy"], "text": "But it is not merely this affair on which my dislike is founded. Long before it had taken place, my opinion of you was decided. Your character was unfolded in the recital which I received many months ago from Mr. Wickham. On this subject, what can you have to say? In what imaginary act of friendship can you here defend yourself? or under what misrepresentation can you here impose upon others?"}, {"speaker": "Mr. Darcy", "speak_to": ["Elizabeth"], "text": "You take an eager interest in that gentleman’s concerns."}, {"speaker": "Elizabeth", "speak_to": ["Mr. Darcy"], "text": "Who that knows what his misfortunes have been can help feeling an interest in him?"}, {"speaker": "Mr. Darcy", "speak_to": ["Elizabeth"], "text": "His misfortunes! repeated Darcy, contemptuously--yes, his misfortunes have been great indeed."}]}

If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone."}, {"speaker": "Holmes", "speak_to": ["Watson", "the Count Von Kramm"], "text": "It is both, or none. {"dialogues": [
  {"speaker": "the King of Bohemia", "speak_to": ["Sherlock Holmes", "Dr. Watson"], "text": "The King of Bohemia inquired whether they had received his note, adding that he had informed them he would call."},
  {"speaker": "Sherlock Holmes", "speak_to": ["Dr. Watson", "the King of Bohemia"], "text": "Sherlock Holmes requested that the King take a seat and introduced him to Dr. Watson, his friend and colleague, who occasionally assisted him in his cases, and then asked whom he had the honour to address."},
  {"speaker": "the King of Bohemia", "speak_to": ["Sherlock Holmes", "Dr. Watson"], "text": "The King of Bohemia stated that he should be addressed as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman, and expressed his hope that Dr. Watson was a man of honour and discretion, someone he could trust with a matter of extreme importance, otherwise he would prefer to speak with Sherlock Holmes alone."},
  {"speaker": "Sherlock Holmes", "speak_to": ["Dr. Watson", "the King of Bohemia"], "text": "Sherlock Holmes assured them that both were suitable, or neither, and that the King could speak freely before Dr. Watson as he would with him."},
  {"speaker": "the King of Bohemia", "speak_to": ["Sherlock Holmes", "Dr. Watson"], "text": "The King of Bohemia explained that he needed them both to bind to absolute secrecy for two years, after which the matter would be unimportant, and that currently it was of such weight it could influence European history."},
  {"speaker": "Sherlock Holmes", "speak_to": ["the King of Bohemia"], "text": "Sherlock Holmes promised."},
  {"speaker": "Dr. Watson", "speak_to": ["the King of Bohemia"], "text": "Dr. Watson concurred."},
  {"speaker": "the King of Bohemia", "speak_to": ["Sherlock Holmes", "Dr. Watson"], "text": "The King of Bohemia apologized for the mask, explaining that the person who employed him wished his agent to remain unknown, and he confessed that the title he had used was not his own."},
  {"speaker": "Sherlock Holmes", "speak_to": ["the King of Bohemia"], "text": "Sherlock Holmes revealed that he had been aware of this."},
  {"speaker": "the King of Bohemia", "speak_to": ["Sherlock Holmes", "Dr. Watson"], "text": "The King of Bohemia emphasized that the circumstances were delicate and required precautions to prevent a scandal that could compromise the House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia."},
  {"speaker": "Sherlock Holmes", "speak_to": ["the King of Bohemia"], "text": "Sherlock Holmes confirmed that he too was aware of that."},
  {"speaker": "Sherlock Holmes", "speak_to": ["the King of Bohemia"], "text": "Sherlock Holmes suggested that if the King would state his case, he would be better able to advise him."},
  {"speaker": "the King of Bohemia", "speak_to": ["Sherlock Holmes", "Dr. Watson"], "text": "The King of Bohemia acknowledged that he was right and then asked why he had attempted to conceal his identity, stating that he was, in fact, the King."}
]}

{"dialogues": [{"speaker": "GWENDOLEN", "speak_to": ["LADY BRACKNELL"], "text": "I am engaged to Mr. Worthing, mamma."}, {"speaker": "LADY BRACKNELL", "speak_to": ["GWENDOLEN"], "text": "Pardon me, you are not engaged to any one. When you do become engaged to some one, I, or your father, should his health permit him, will inform you of the fact. An engagement should come on a young girl as a surprise, pleasant or unpleasant, as the case may be. It is hardly a matter that she could be allowed to arrange for herself . . . And now I have a few questions to put to you, Mr. Worthing. While I am making these inquiries, you, Gwendolen, will wait for me below in the carriage."}, {"speaker": "GWENDOLEN", "speak_to": ["LADY BRACKNELL"], "text": "Mamma!"}, {"speaker": "LADY BRACKNELL", "speak_to": ["GWENDOLEN"], "text": "In the carriage, Gwendolen!"}, {"speaker": "LADY BRACKNELL", "speak_to": ["GWENDOLEN"], "text": "Gwendolen, the carriage!"}, {"speaker": "GWENDOLEN", "speak_to": [], "text": "Yes, mamma."}, {"speaker": "LADY BRACKNELL", "speak_to": ["JACK"], "text": "You can take a seat, Mr. Worthing."}, {"speaker": "JACK", "speak_to": ["LADY BRACKNELL"], "text": "Thank you, Lady Bracknell, I prefer standing."}, {"speaker": "LADY BRACKNELL", "speak_to": ["JACK"], "text": "I feel bound to tell you that you are not down on my list of eligible young men, although I have the same list as the dear Duchess of Bolton has. We work together, in fact. However, I am quite ready to enter your name, should your answers be what a really affectionate mother requires. Do you smoke?"}, {"speaker": "JACK", "speak_to": ["LADY BRACKNELL"], "text": "Well, yes, I must admit I smoke."}, {"speaker": "LADY BRACKNELL", "speak_to": ["JACK"], "text": "I am glad to hear it. A man should always have an occupation of some kind. There are far too many idle men in London as it is. How old are you?"}, {"speaker": "JACK", "speak_to": ["LADY BRACKNELL"], "text": "Twenty-nine."}, {"speaker": "LADY BRACKNELL", "speak_to": ["JACK"], "text": "A very good age to be married at. I have always been of opinion that a man who desires to get married should know either everything or nothing. Which do you know?"}, {"speaker": "JACK", "speak_to": ["LADY BRACKNELL"], "text": "I know nothing, Lady Bracknell."}, {"speaker": "LADY BRACKNELL", "speak_to": ["JACK"], "text": "I am pleased to hear it. I do not approve of anything that tampers with natural ignorance. Ignorance is like a delicate exotic fruit; touch it and the bloom is gone. The whole theory of modern education is radically unsound. Fortunately in England, at any rate, education produces no effect whatsoever. If it did, it would prove a serious danger to the upper classes, and probably lead to acts of violence in Grosvenor Square. What is your income?"}, {"speaker": "JACK", "speak_to": ["LADY BRACKNELL"], "text": "Between seven and eight thousand a year."}, {"speaker": "LADY BRACKNELL", "speak_to": ["JACK"], "text": "In land, or in investments?"}, {"speaker": "JACK", "speak_to": ["LADY BRACKNELL"], "text": "In investments, chiefly."}, {"speaker": "LADY BRACKNELL", "speak_to": ["JACK"], "text": "What between the duties expected of one during one’s lifetime, and the duties exacted from one after one’s death, land has ceased to be either a profit or a pleasure. It gives one position, and prevents one from keeping it up. That’s all that can be said about land."}, {"speaker": "JACK", "speak_to": ["LADY BRACKNELL"], "text": "I have a country house with some land, of course, attached to it, about fifteen hundred acres, I believe; but I don’t depend on that for my real income. Well, that point can be cleared up afterwards. You have a town house, I hope? A girl with a simple, unspoiled nature, like Gwendolen, could hardly be expected to reside in the country."}, {"speaker": "JACK", "speak_to": ["LADY BRACKNELL"], "text": "Well, I own a house in Belgrave Square, but it is let by the year to Lady Bloxham.   {"speaker": "Lady Bracknell", "speak_to": ["Gwendolen"], "text": "Lady Bracknell remarked that Gwendolen was not engaged to anyone and explained that an engagement should come as a surprise, pleasant or unpleasant, and that she or Gwendolen’s father would inform her of the fact. She added that it was hardly a matter for her to arrange for herself and then announced that she had a few questions to put to Mr. Worthing, instructing Gwendolen to wait for her below in the carriage."},
  {"speaker": "Gwendolen", "speak_to": ["Lady Bracknell"], "text": "Gwendolen protested to Lady Bracknell."},
  {"speaker": "Lady Bracknell", "speak_to": ["Gwendolen"], "text": "Lady Bracknell instructed Gwendolen to go to the carriage."},
  {"speaker": "Lady Bracknell", "speak_to": ["Gwendolen"], "text": "Lady Bracknell repeated her instruction for Gwendolen to go to the carriage."},
  {"speaker": "Gwendolen", "speak_to": ["Lady Bracknell"], "text": "Gwendolen acknowledged Lady Bracknell’s instruction."},
  {"speaker": "Lady Bracknell", "speak_to": ["Jack"], "text": "Lady Bracknell invited Jack to take a seat."},
  {"speaker": "Jack", "speak_to": ["Lady Bracknell"], "text": "Jack thanked Lady Bracknell but stated that he preferred standing."},
  {"speaker": "Lady Bracknell", "speak_to": ["Jack"], "text": "Lady Bracknell explained that she felt bound to tell Jack that he was not listed among the eligible young men, though she shared the same list as the Duchess of Bolton. She added that she was ready to enter his name if his answers were what a mother required and then inquired whether he smoked."},
  {"speaker": "Jack", "speak_to": ["Lady Bracknell"], "text": "Jack admitted that he smoked."},
  {"speaker": "Lady Bracknell", "speak_to": ["Jack"], "text": "Lady Bracknell expressed her pleasure, stating that a man should always have an occupation and that there were too many idle men in London. She then asked him how old he was."},
  {"speaker": "Jack", "speak_to": ["Lady Bracknell"], "text": "Jack replied that he was twenty-nine years old."},
  {"speaker": "Lady Bracknell", "speak_to": ["Jack"], "text": "Lady Bracknell commented that it was a very good age to be married and stated that she believed a man who desired to get married should know either everything or nothing, asking him which he knew."},
  {"speaker": "Jack", "speak_to": ["Lady Bracknell"], "text": "Jack responded that he knew nothing, Lady Bracknell."},
  {"speaker": "Lady Bracknell", "speak_to": ["Jack"], "text": "Lady Bracknell expressed her pleasure, stating that she did not approve of anything that tampered with natural ignorance and that ignorance was like a delicate exotic fruit. She continued by criticizing modern education and suggesting that it would be dangerous to the upper classes. Finally, she asked about his income."},
  {"speaker": "Jack", "speak_to": ["Lady Bracknell"], "text": "Jack stated that his income was between seven and eight thousand a year."},
  {"speaker": "Lady Bracknell", "speak_to": ["Jack"], "text": "Lady Bracknell inquired whether the income was in land or investments."},
  {"speaker": "Jack", "speak_to": ["Lady Bracknell"], "text": "Jack clarified that it was chiefly in investments."},
  {"speaker": "Lady Bracknell", "speak_to": ["Jack"], "text": "Lady Bracknell observed that land had ceased to be either a profit or a pleasure and that it only provided position. She then asked about a country house."},
  {"speaker": "Jack", "speak_to": ["Lady Bracknell"], "text": "Jack explained that he had a country house with fifteen hundred acres attached, but that he did not depend on it for his income, adding that the poachers seemed to be the only ones benefiting from it."},
  {"speaker": "Lady Bracknell", "speak_to": ["Jack"], "text": "Lady Bracknell inquired about the number of bedrooms in the country house and then asked if he had a town house."},
  {"speaker": "Jack", "speak_to": ["Lady Bracknell"], "text": "Jack stated that he owned a house in Belgrave Square, but it was let by the year to Lady Bloxham, adding that he could get it back at six months’ notice."},
  {"speaker": "Lady Bracknell", "speak_to": ["Jack"], "text": "Lady Bracknell expressed that she did not know Lady Bloxham."},
  {"speaker": "Jack", "speak_to": ["Lady Bracknell"], "text": "Jack explained that Lady Bloxham did not go about very much and that she was considerably advanced in years."},
  {"speaker": "Lady Bracknell", "speak_to": ["Jack"], "text": "Lady Bracknell remarked that age was no guarantee of respectability of character and asked for the number of the house in Belgrave Square."},
  {"speaker": "Jack", "speak_to": ["Lady Bracknell"], "text": "Jack replied that the number was 149."}
]}

{"dialogues": [{"speaker": "Sandip", "speak_to": ["Queen"], "text": "Whither would you flee, Queen?"}, {"speaker": "Sandip", "speak_to": ["Nikhil"], "text": "I say, Nikhil, don't you keep Browning among your books here? I was just telling Queen Bee of our college club. Do you remember that contest of ours over the translation of those lines from Browning? You don't?"}, {"speaker": "Sandip", "speak_to": ["Nikhil"], "text": "I managed to get together the words to render it into Bengali, somehow, but the result was hardly likely to be a 'joy forever' to the people of Bengal. I really did think at one time that I was on the verge of becoming a poet, but Providence was kind enough to save me from that disaster. Do you remember old Dakshina? If he had not become a Salt Inspector, he would have been a poet. I remember his rendering to this day ..."}, {"speaker": "Sandip", "speak_to": ["Queen Bee"], "text": "No, Queen Bee, it is no use rummaging those bookshelves. Nikhil has ceased to read poetry since his marriage--perhaps he has no further need for it. But I suppose 'the fever fit of poesy', as the Sanskrit has it, is about to attack me again."}, {"speaker": "Sandip", "speak_to": ["Nikhil"], "text": "I have come to give you a warning, Sandip."}, {"speaker": "Sandip", "speak_to": ["Nikhil"], "text": "About the fever fit of poesy?"}, {"speaker": "Nikhil", "speak_to": ["Sandip"], "text": "For some time, Mahomedan preachers have been about stirring up the local Mussulmans. They are all wild with you, and may attack you any moment."}, {"speaker": "Sandip", "speak_to": ["Nikhil"], "text": "Are you come to advise flight?"}, {"speaker": "Nikhil", "speak_to": ["Sandip"], "text": "I have come to give you information, not to offer advice."}, {"speaker": "Sandip", "speak_to": ["Nikhil"], "text": "Had these estates been mine, such a warning would have been necessary for the preachers, not for me. If, instead of trying to frighten me, you give them a taste of your intimidation, that would be worthier both of you and me. Do you know that your weakness is weakening your neighbouring zamindars also?"}, {"speaker": "Nikhil", "speak_to": ["Sandip"], "text": "I did not offer you my advice, Sandip. I wish you, too, would refrain from giving me yours. Besides, it is useless. And there is another thing I want to tell you. You and your followers have been secretly worrying and oppressing my tenantry. I cannot allow that any longer. So I must ask you to leave my territory."}, {"speaker": "Sandip", "speak_to": ["Nikhil"], "text": "For fear of the Mussulmans, or is there any other fear you have to threaten me with?"}]}

{"dialogues": [
  {"speaker": "Sandip", "speak_to": ["Bimala"], "text": "Sandip inquired of Bimala as to where she intended to flee, addressing her as Queen."},
  {"speaker": "Sandip", "speak_to": ["Nikhil"], "text": "Sandip remarked to Nikhil that he questioned why Browning was not among his books, recalling a conversation with Bimala about a college contest involving Browning's translation, and asking if Nikhil remembered it."},
  {"speaker": "Sandip", "speak_to": ["Nikhil"], "text": "Sandip explained to Nikhil that he had managed to translate Browning into Bengali, though the result was far from a lasting joy for Bengal, and that he once believed himself on the verge of becoming a poet, but Providence had intervened. He then recalled old Dakshina, suggesting that had he not become a Salt Inspector, he would have been a poet."},
  {"speaker": "Sandip", "speak_to": ["Bimala"], "text": "Sandip informed Bimala that it was pointless for her to search the bookshelves, as Nikhil had ceased reading poetry since his marriage, and that he suspected a return of his poetic inspiration."},
  {"speaker": "Sandip", "speak_to": ["Nikhil"], "text": "Sandip stated that Nikhil had come to give him a warning."},
  {"speaker": "Sandip", "speak_to": ["Nikhil"], "text": "Sandip inquired of Nikhil whether the warning concerned his poetic inspiration."},
  {"speaker": "Nikhil", "speak_to": ["Sandip"], "text": "Nikhil told Sandip that Mahomedan preachers had been stirring up the local Mussulmans, who were agitated and might attack him at any moment."},
  {"speaker": "Sandip", "speak_to": ["Nikhil"], "text": "Sandip asked Nikhil if he had come to advise flight."},
  {"speaker": "Nikhil", "speak_to": ["Sandip"], "text": "Nikhil clarified to Sandip that he had come to provide information, not to offer advice."},
  {"speaker": "Sandip", "speak_to": ["Nikhil"], "text": "Sandip commented to Nikhil that a warning would have been necessary for the preachers, not for him, had the estates been his, and suggested that Nikhil's weakness was also undermining neighboring zamindars."},
  {"speaker": "Nikhil", "speak_to": ["Sandip"], "text": "Nikhil pointed out to Sandip that he had not offered advice, and requested that Sandip refrain from giving it, adding that it was futile. He then stated that he needed to inform Sandip that his followers had been secretly oppressing his tenantry, and demanded that he leave his territory."},
  {"speaker": "Sandip", "speak_to": ["Nikhil"], "text": "Sandip questioned Nikhil, asking whether the threat was due to fear of the Mussulmans or some other apprehension."}
]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "It is as you say, my dear. I have seen to the wine and the rice, and everything is as you wished, for your comfort. May the spirits be kind to you and ease your passing, and may your son remember your wisdom always.", "speak_to": ["O-lan"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "It is... it is all done as you wish, my dear. I have seen to the wine, the rice, everything you asked for, so that you might be content. It pleases me to see you at peace.", "speak_to": ["O-lan"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "It is all prepared as you wish, my dear. I have seen to it myself, that the rice is hot and the lard and sugar are plentiful, and the fruits are... are as they should be. May the spirits be pleased with this offering, and may it bring you peace.", "speak_to": ["O-lan"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "It is as you say, my dear. I have seen to the rice, and the wine flows freely. I only wish to see you comfortable, and that all is as you desire for your… for our family’s future.", "speak_to": ["O-lan"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "Your father is a man of the earth, but he lacks a certain… foresight. Ensure that the eldest of your children, *your* children, remembers the value of land, of holdings. Do not let him squander what I have built for this family.", "speak_to": ["the eldest son"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "The maid possesses a certain...robustness, does she not? Ensure she understands the importance of bearing sons, Wang Lung. It is not enough to simply *be*; she must *produce*.", "speak_to": ["Wang Lung", "the maid"]}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "Comfort is a fleeting thing, Wang Lung. Do not mistake my acceptance for satisfaction; I simply understand the inevitable. See that the maid understands her place, and that she remembers the lineage she now carries – a lineage bought with my labor.", "speak_to": ["Wang Lung", "the maid"]}
{"intend": "speak", "content": "I will, Mother. I understand your wishes regarding the land; I will certainly see to it. I trust my children will respect its value.", "speak_to": ["O-lan"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "Yes, my dear, the maid seems strong, a good woman. I will speak with her, certainly, and remind her of her duty to the family… it is a great responsibility, you know, to carry on the line. It is a blessing, a blessing we must all cherish.", "speak_to": ["O-lan", "the maid"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "The maid… she is young, and possesses a certain… diligence. See that she understands her place, Wang Lung, and that she remembers who provides for her. A woman’s usefulness lies not in beauty, but in her capacity to bear sons.", "speak_to": ["Wang Lung", "the maid"]}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "The maid is a suitable match, I suppose; she possesses a certain… diligence. But remember, my son, a woman’s worth is not measured solely in her labors. Ensure she understands her place within this house, and that she bears sons, strong sons, to carry on my name.", "speak_to": ["the eldest son"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "A blessing, you say? Blessings are fleeting, Wang Lung. Ensure the maid understands that a woman’s worth is measured not in smiles, but in the sons she brings into this world – sons who will remember our name long after I am gone.", "speak_to": ["Wang Lung", "the maid"]}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "My dear, you worry so much about these things. Surely, the lineage will be taken care of; we have sons, and grandsons… it is all as it should be. Let us not trouble ourselves with such matters now, let us focus on your comfort.", "speak_to": ["O-lan"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "My son, you are a good man, and I trust you will heed your mother’s words. It is a weighty burden you carry, to safeguard our legacy, but I have faith you will do what is right, for the family’s sake. We all wish you and your bride a long and prosperous life together.", "speak_to": ["the eldest son"]}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "Wang Lung, you speak of comfort as if it were a shield against the inevitable decline. Do not believe that sons and grandsons guarantee a family's endurance; only diligent labor and unwavering vigilance can achieve that. I trust you will impress upon the maid the importance of her duties, for the future of this house rests, in part, upon her ability to bear strong sons.", "speak_to": ["Wang Lung", "the maid"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "She is right to be concerned; I will impress upon my sons the importance of maintaining our holdings. I hope they will listen and follow her guidance.", "speak_to": ["O-lan"]}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "Your father speaks of faith, but faith alone does not fill a granary. Ensure that your bride understands that strength lies not merely in bearing sons, but in securing their future – through alliances, through wisdom, through *careful* management. I have seen empires crumble from within, my son; do not let our family suffer a similar fate.", "speak_to": ["the eldest son"]}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": ["O-lan", "Wang Lung", "the eldest son"]}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "My dear wife, you speak with such wisdom, as always. I will, of course, see to it that the maid understands her responsibilities, though I confess, such matters are not easily conveyed; I only hope she listens and learns well.", "speak_to": ["O-lan", "the maid"]}
{"intend": "speak", "content": "I will endeavor to remember your words, Mother. I trust my bride will prove capable of understanding, with my guidance.", "speak_to": ["O-lan"]}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}
{"intend": "speak", "content": "She worries about the future, doesn't she? I will ensure everything is as she wishes, Father. The maid and I will do our best.", "speak_to": ["Wang Lung"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "Hope is a dangerous indulgence, Wang Lung. Do not mistake the maid’s youth for promise; I have seen too many blooms wither before their time. Ensure she understands that a woman’s worth lies not in her beauty, but in her ability to provide strong sons for this house.", "speak_to": ["Wang Lung", "the maid"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "Your bride possesses a quietness that is… useful. But quietness can be mistaken for weakness, and weakness invites exploitation. See to it that she understands the subtle currents of power; a woman who understands power can be a formidable shield, even if she wields it silently.", "speak_to": ["the eldest son"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "Wang Lung nodded slowly, attempting a reassuring smile towards his wife, though his face betrayed a deep worry. He gestured to a servant to ensure everyone indeed had wine, hoping to please her and quiet the turmoil in his heart. It was important that she felt everything was as she wished, he thought, though he couldn't quite grasp the meaning behind her words about feeding and caring for… him.", "speak_to": ["O-lan"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "Your mother… she always thinks of everything, doesn’t she? It’s good that you are taking care of things, son, and that you and the maid will see to it all, just as she asks. I’ll… I’ll be here, watching over her.", "speak_to": ["the eldest son"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "She speaks wisely, Mother. I will remind the maid of her duties, and ensure she understands the importance of her role within the family.", "speak_to": ["O-lan", "the maid"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "Your mother speaks with such wisdom, my son. I... I only hope you can take it all in, and that your bride, she will also understand, and… and be a good help to you, as your mother wishes. It is a great responsibility, yes, a great responsibility.", "speak_to": ["the eldest son"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "She observed the maid, a tremor passing through her aged frame, and inquired as to the young woman’s understanding of her duty to the family, adding that lineage was not merely a matter of bearing children, but of nurturing them with the same fierce devotion she had shown her own. It was crucial, she indicated, that this new daughter-in-law comprehended the weight of responsibility she was about to assume, or the legacy would surely crumble.","speak_to": ["the maid", "the eldest son", "Wang Lung"]}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}
{"intend": "speak", "content": "She is very clear in her instructions. I shall ensure my bride understands the importance of these matters, Father.", "speak_to": ["Wang Lung"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "Wang Lung expressed his agreement with his wife’s observations, nodding again and clearing his throat nervously. He hoped she understood that the young woman, and his son, would strive to uphold the family’s honor and continue the lineage as she desired, though he privately worried about the immense burden he was placing upon them. He gestured for another servant to bring a fresh cup of tea, attempting to appear calm and supportive.", "speak_to": ["O-lan", "the eldest son", "the maid"]}
{"intend": "speak", "content": "The maid is capable, Father. I believe she will manage well. We will, of course, follow Mother’s instructions carefully.", "speak_to": ["Wang Lung"]}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "It is true, my son, your mother has always been… insightful. I trust you will listen to her, and your bride will heed her words as well; a strong family is built on such foundations, isn’t it? We all want that, don't we?", "speak_to": ["the eldest son"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "O-lan regarded the maid with a penetrating gaze, then turned her attention to her eldest son, and remarked that while lineage ensured survival, it was the cultivation of virtue that secured prosperity. She emphasized that a woman’s strength lay not solely in the bearing of sons, but in the wisdom imparted to them, a wisdom born of hardship and tempered by resilience. It was a legacy, she stated, that this young woman must strive to emulate, lest the foundations of their house prove unstable.", "speak_to": ["the maid", "the eldest son"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "It’s… it’s a comfort to know you’re both thinking of her wishes, son. I trust you both will do what is right, and… and that you’ll remember her guidance, always. She has a good heart, your mother, and wants only what is best for the family.", "speak_to": ["the eldest son", "the maid"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "Your father speaks of conveying responsibility, eldest son, but words are wind. I require more than assurances; I require action, a demonstration of understanding. See to it that she comprehends that my legacy, our legacy, demands more than mere compliance.", "speak_to": ["the eldest son"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "I believe she is correct to emphasize strength, Father. I will speak with my bride about these… subtleties. It is important for her to understand.", "speak_to": ["Wang Lung"]}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}
{"intend": "speak", "content": "I will, Mother. I will speak with her again, and ensure she understands your expectations. Everything will be as you wish.", "speak_to": ["O-lan"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "Yes, a strong family... it's everything, isn't it? Your mother, she’s always known these things so well. I just… I hope she’s not troubling herself too much with these matters now, my son, when she should be resting.", "speak_to": ["the eldest son"]}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "You speak of assurances, eldest son, but I see a boy’s eagerness to please, not a man’s resolve. Tell me, do you truly grasp the weight of what I ask? The continuation of this line is not a matter of pleasantries, but of survival.", "speak_to": ["the eldest son"]}
{"intend": "speak", "content": "She is concerned for our future, Father. I will do my best to uphold her wishes and ensure the family thrives.", "speak_to": ["Wang Lung"]}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}
{"intend": "speak", "content": "I understand, Father. We will not forget her concerns. I am certain we can fulfill her expectations.", "speak_to": ["Wang Lung"]}
{"intend": "speak", "content": "I understand, Mother. I will… I will strive to ensure she understands the importance of providing sons for the family’s future.", "speak_to": ["O-lan"]}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "It is important that we all remain strong, Father. I will speak with the steward about the arrangements; everything will be handled properly.", "speak_to": ["Wang Lung"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "Striving is insufficient, eldest son. The earth yields nothing to mere effort; it demands constant tending, diligent sacrifice. Ensure she understands that barrenness is a curse upon a house, a stain upon our name.", "speak_to": ["the eldest son"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "It is a good thing you listen to your mother, my son. She has always had a sharp mind, and wisdom comes from experience, doesn't it? I just pray that all these… arrangements… bring you and your bride much happiness and prosperity.", "speak_to": ["the eldest son"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "Wang Lung nodded slowly, attempting a reassuring smile towards his wife. He murmured that, of course, everyone would have wine, and he would see to it that the sweet rice dish was prepared just as she desired, with all the lard and sugar and fruit. It was important that all were comfortable, he said, for such an occasion.", "speak_to": ["O-lan"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "It’s… it’s a heavy burden, these instructions, isn't it, son? I trust you'll be able to bear it, and that you and the maid will be able to… to see them through, as your mother wishes. I only want what’s best for my family, and I believe you both do too.", "speak_to": ["the eldest son", "the maid"]}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "It is… reassuring to know she is focused on these things, Father. I trust everything will proceed as she wishes, and that my bride will adapt well to her counsel.", "speak_to": ["Wang Lung"]}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}
{"intend": "speak", "content": "I will remind her, Mother, of your words. It is my duty to see to the family’s prosperity, and I will do what I can.", "speak_to": ["O-lan"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "It’s good, it’s very good, that you both understand what she says. My heart... it feels a little uneasy with all these instructions, but she knows best, doesn't she? I just want everyone to be content and that the family continues strong, that’s all.", "speak_to": ["the eldest son", "the maid"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "O-lan observed the maid, her gaze lingering on the girl’s youthful countenance, and remarked that a woman’s worth was not measured in beauty, but in the strength of her spirit and the diligence of her hands. It would be the maid’s duty to ensure the continuation of this lineage, and she must remember that the land demanded respect and unwavering obedience. Such things were more valuable than any fleeting charm.", "speak_to": ["the maid", "the eldest son", "Wang Lung"]}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "Your father means well, eldest son, but words are easily forgotten. Ensure she understands that a woman’s worth lies not in her beauty or her gentleness, but in the strength of her womb. Remind her that I have borne you and your brothers, and that is my legacy; it is her burden to continue it.", "speak_to": ["the eldest son"]}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}
{"intend": "speak", "content": "I will, Mother. I will be certain she appreciates the significance of what you’ve said. It is… important to remember these things.", "speak_to": ["O-lan"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "Contentment is a fleeting thing, Wang Lung. Do not mistake my concerns for undue burden; a foundation built on shifting sands will surely collapse. Ensure your son understands the weight of his lineage, and that his bride proves worthy of it.", "speak_to": ["Wang Lung", "the eldest son", "the maid"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "He offered a brief nod, acknowledging his mother's words regarding the maid’s duty. It was important that she understood the expectations placed upon her, he indicated, hoping it would provide some measure of comfort. He then glanced at his father, a silent plea for direction passing between them.", "speak_to": ["O-lan", "Wang Lung", "the maid"]}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "Your eagerness pleases me, eldest son, but I perceive a fragility in your resolve. Do not merely *tell* her these things; *impress* them upon her, so that they become the very breath she draws. A family’s survival is not a matter of pleasantries, but of unwavering duty.", "speak_to": ["the eldest son"]}
{"intend": "silent", "content": "", "speak_to": []}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "Wang Lung cleared his throat, a nervous gesture, and indicated that his son spoke wisely. He hoped the young woman understood the great responsibility laid before her, and that she would strive to be a good wife and mother, bringing honor to the family. It was a great burden, he murmured, and he trusted she would find strength within herself to bear it.", "speak_to": ["the eldest son", "the maid"]}

{"intend": "speak", "content": "A monument, you say? Yes, Pip, a monument… and who, pray tell, is the sculptor? Who carves these memories into the stone of my being? It is I, of course, isn’t it? I, the architect of my own despair.", "speak_to": ["Pip"]}
